blocking_rules: DOC-015 defines player-club assignment validity fields as critical where required for the currently valid assignment; missing values receive no replacement value and block the affected player/period.
DEC-015 / REQ-SSOT-003 prohibit inventing replacement values for missing binding SSOT master data.
bms/w3_1_ssot.py requires club_valid_from to construct a confirmed current player_club_assignment and reach SSOT_PROCESSABLE.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not default unknown club_valid_from to season start 2026-08-28.
Do not use roster capture date as a proxy for the real assignment start.
Do not infer validity boundaries from names or roster membership alone.

p_and_i_options.title: Source exact validity boundaries
p_and_i_options.description: Commission evidence acquisition for the missing current-roster club_valid_from values and persist each value with reproducible source reference and source precision before full-league materialization.

p_and_i_options.title: Approve a model/technical precision extension
p_and_i_options.description: Introduce an explicitly governed distinction between real-world assignment start and point-in-time confirmed current membership (for example observed_valid_at / boundary_precision). This requires a governance/domain-model decision and corresponding code/test change; it must not silently reinterpret existing valid_from semantics.

p_and_i_options.title: Narrow materialization scope
p_and_i_options.description: Materialize only the subset with fully evidenced assignment validity and keep all other current-roster players SSOT_BLOCKED. This would not satisfy a full-league ready state and therefore needs explicit pilot-scope approval.

recommended_p_and_i_question: Does W3.1 require historically exact club_valid_from for every current roster player, or may a separately modelled point-in-time confirmed-membership interval satisfy current-assignment processability without fabricating the true assignment start?
